title: A single domestication for maize shown by multilocus microsatellite genotyping
version: PNAS 99(9), pp. 6080–6084; DOI 10.1073/pnas.052125199; Panzea-hosted version-of-record PDF
lineage: Original microsatellite analysis of modern plants, independent of the Xihuatoxtla excavations. The phylogeny concerns sampled regional landraces and wild relatives, not the identity or precise route of maize grown at an ancient site.

passages.locator: Materials and Methods, Figs. 1–2 and Cradle of Maize Domestication, pp. 6080–6083
passages.note: The sampled maize, including Mexican highland and Guatemalan/southern Mexican landraces, grouped within a lineage closest to Balsas teosinte in this study. The geographic inference draws on present-day wild populations.
